entries.title: Genji: Dawn of the Samurai

emulation.notes: PCSX2 is the practical high-resolution capture route for an owned PS2 copy.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 assets and presentation with emulator-side resolution and filtering improvements.

primary.why: Genji: Dawn of the Samurai is a PlayStation 2-only release with no sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease, so the complete original PS2 version is the definitive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PS2 copy on original hardware, or use PCSX2 with an owned copy for higher-resolution capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease was identified.

entries.title: Genji: Days of the Blade

emulation.notes: RPCS3 can be used for owned-copy preservation testing; original PS3 hardware remains the straightforward official route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS3 presentation, potentially improved through emulator-side resolution if RPCS3 compatibility is acceptable.

primary.why: Genji: Days of the Blade is a PlayStation 3-only sequel with no sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease, so the original PS3 version is the complete canonical release.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PS3 copy on PlayStation 3 hardware, or use RPCS3 with an owned copy if compatibility and performance are acceptable on the capture PC.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease was identified.
